text:
maria: Heads up — EU shared-pool saturated this morning for ~30m, one tenant drove continuous 1k+ concurrent streams and bumped p95 from 220ms -> 1.2s. filing INC: https://redwood.ai/issue/INC-3821 :frowning:
aj: ugh, saw that spike in the dashboard. looks like KV cache churn + huge batch pressure. any quick mitigations? :eyes:
devin: can we soft-throttle by score instead of hard evicting? previous hard eviction caused timeouts for many important tenants.
suresh: proposing a "tenant scorecard" that blends recent GPU-ms, queue-length, error-rate, and cost-rate. higher score => higher penalty. penalty is probabilistic admit (p = 1/(1+alpha*score)).
lydia: sounds promising. how do we compute score window and decay? we need something that reacts in ~30–90s but decays in ~10–30m to avoid permanent bans.
maria: agree on short half-life. idea: score = weighted_exp_moving_avg(metric) with half_life=45s, then normalize by tenantSLO.
aj: implementation note: keep per-tenant leaky-bucket tokens + global capacity tokens. if tenant score > threshold -> reduce refill by factor f(score).
devin: pseudocode sketch:
```
score = EMA(gpu_ms, queue_len, err_rate, cost)
admit_prob = 1.0/(1.0 + K*score)
if rand() < admit_prob and global_tokens > 0 and tenant_tokens > 0:
  allow()
else:
  enqueue_or_reject()
```

suresh: for storage use Redis ZSET with TTL per-tenant score + counters. ZSET score field = epoch_ts + tenant_score for quick top-n noisy tenants. helps runbook to detect noisy neighbors.
lydia: add a cooldown hysteresis so tenants don't oscillate: when a penalty is applied, freeze their score reduction for 60s. prevents rapid flip-flop.
maria: we should include a fallback: if noisy tenant persists >5m despite penalties, auto-suggest move to dedicated pool and open SEV ticket to infra-placements team.
aj: metric names to add to dashboards: shared_pool.tenant_score, shared_pool.admit_prob, shared_pool.penalty_state, shared_pool.global_tokens. also expose top_noisy_tenants leaderboard.
devin: need canary rollout — start in eu-west staging pool with conservative K and long half-life; run 48h A/B to measure p95 and wasted tokens.
capacity-bot: alert: eu-west shared-pool token-usage at 92% (generated from monitoring).
suresh: cost note — penalizing by admission prob saves GPU-ms but increases queuing; we need to include cost-per-token in score so we don't penalize cheap low-latency tenants.
lydia: ops runbook todo: (1) how to manually pin tenant to dedicated pool, (2) how to force reset score for tenant, (3) when to escalate to placements. I'll draft and post.
maria: can someone spin up a quick PoC PR? target: small lib in serving runtime + admission hook + prometheus metrics. if nobody volunteers I'll pick it up tomorrow.
aj: I'll own Redis schema + dashboards. devin you want runtime hook PR?
devin: yep, I'll open draft by EOD. include unit tests for deterministic admit decisions.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: INC-3821 updated with mitigation plan and runbook link. we'll review after PoC results. :thumbsup:
